correction_lesson: A team's total wins = home wins (ft_result='H' where it is home_team_id) PLUS away wins (ft_result='A' where it is away_team_id). ft_result is from the HOME team's perspective, so counting only one side undercounts.
description: Total-wins pitfall (scaled): home wins + away wins.

turns.query: How many matches did Manchester City win in total in the 2020-2021 Premier League season?
turns.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS wins FROM (SELECT 1 FROM matches m JOIN seasons s ON m.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id JOIN teams t ON m.home_team_id = t.team_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2020-2021' AND t.team_name = 'Manchester City' AND m.ft_result = 'H' UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM matches m JOIN seasons s ON m.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id JOIN teams t ON m.away_team_id = t.team_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2020-2021' AND t.team_name = 'Manchester City' AND m.ft_result = 'A') x;

turns.query: How many games did Chelsea win across the whole 2024-2025 Premier League season?
turns.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS wins FROM (SELECT 1 FROM matches m JOIN seasons s ON m.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id JOIN teams t ON m.home_team_id = t.team_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2024-2025' AND t.team_name = 'Chelsea' AND m.ft_result = 'H' UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM matches m JOIN seasons s ON m.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id JOIN teams t ON m.away_team_id = t.team_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2024-2025' AND t.team_name = 'Chelsea' AND m.ft_result = 'A') x;
